intro: A copy of Atlas’s database, made every day on this Mac.

overdue.title: No recent backup: none for {{days}}
overdue.body: {{cmd}} warns about this until one succeeds.

failed.title: The last backup failed
failed.body: Check the folder below, then back up now.
failed.doctor: {{cmd}} warns about this until one succeeds.

none.title: No recent backup: none yet
none.body: The first runs {{when}}, or back up now.
none.bodyOff: Daily backups are off. Back up now to make the first one.

slot.unknown: {{day}}: older than the runs Atlas lists.

enabledSub: At the time below. Back up now works either way.
enabledOffSub: Daily backups are off. Back up now still works, and {{cmd}} warns after 26 hours.
folderHint: An absolute path on this Mac, outside the Atlas folder. Atlas checks it can write there.
timeSub: Every day, in Baghdad time like the team’s schedule.
keepSub: About {{size}} at today’s size. Older copies are deleted after a new one succeeds.
keepSubNone: Older copies are deleted after a new one succeeds.
savedOffBody: Daily backups are off. Back up now still works.
conflict: These settings changed in another window. Your edits are kept on top of version {{v}}; save again.

e500.title: Couldn’t save the backup settings
e500.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Your changes are still here.

listNote_one: Atlas keeps the newest copy and deletes older ones after a new backup succeeds.
listNote_other: Atlas keeps the newest {{count}} copies and deletes older ones after a new backup succeeds.
copyPathAria: Copy the path of the {{day}} backup

r.s2: Restore the backup you chose in the list above. This replaces everything in Atlas’s database. Put your database password where it says <DB_PASSWORD>.
r.s3: Start Atlas again, then check it. It checks your OKX account before it does anything.
r.warn: Restoring replaces everything in Atlas’s database with the backup. Atlas never restores by itself.
r.note: The same steps, with the Docker variant, are in {{file}}.
r.none: Once a backup exists, the steps to restore it appear here.

failBody: The error is in the list of kept backups.

e429.title: A backup was just requested
e429.body: Atlas starts one backup a minute at most. Try again in a minute.

eRun.title: Couldn’t start a backup
eRun.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Try again in a moment.

err.title: Couldn’t load your backups
err.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.
